nodes.title: SG-6 In-scene object interaction anchored to the object, hotspot path removed
nodes.body:
Context: BootScene already builds SceneObjects from content, highlights them on hover or focus, and emits objectClick. The only on-canvas label is a Phaser Text showing the plain name. Actions appear in a separate ActionMenu panel that is not anchored to the object. Desired behavior: while an object is hovered or focused, a DOM overlay shows an upper-case name plate above the object and its content-defined actions (INSPECT, SEARCH, PUSH) beneath it. The overlay is anchored by a pure function of native position, scale, canvas offset and DPR, and is recomputed on resize. Every object and action is reachable by Tab, arrows, Enter and Space, with a live region and labels read from the same game state. Expected result: the old unanchored ActionMenu is replaced and no hotspot path remains. Why: the framed reference interface shows actions on the object.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given an object is hovered or keyboard-focused, When the overlay renders, Then a name plate above the object shows its content name in upper case and buttons beneath show its available action labels
- Given the anchor inputs (native position, bounds, scale, canvas offset, DPR), When the anchor function runs, Then it returns the same screen point for the same inputs and a different point after the zoom or offset changes
- Given a keyboard user presses Tab, arrows, Enter and Space, When focus reaches an object and its actions, Then each is reachable and activatable and the live region announces the focused object
- Given the source tree, When searched, Then SceneView, HOTSPOTS and ASSET_PATHS do not appear in code or tests and the unanchored ActionMenu is no longer rendered


## Scope
- In scope: Pure anchor function
- In scope: Content-driven action list
- In scope: DOM overlay with name plate and action buttons
- In scope: Hand cursor on interactive objects
- In scope: Keyboard flow and ARIA live region
- In scope: Removal of ActionMenu and leftover hotspot-path names
- Out of scope: New rooms or story content
- Out of scope: Backend changes
- Out of scope: Audio
- Out of scope: Deployment
- Out of scope: Repository clean-up beyond the hotspot path
- Preserve: objectClick and game.act flow
- Preserve: Existing focus store and keyboard handling in BootScene
- Preserve: Phaser 3.90.x pin
- Preserve: 480x270 native resolution with whole-number zoom


## Technical constraints
- Phaser stays on 3.90.x (~3.90.0 pin and guard tests stay)
- React, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind, Radix and Zustand stay
- Keep the Go API contracts; no mock data in place of real API calls
- Scene content stays data-driven: no object, position or asset id hardcoded in a scene class
- One native scene resolution of 480x270, scaled by whole numbers only, nearest-neighbour
- One shared palette of at most 48 colours used by art and UI
- Tests are unit tests with every dependency mocked


## Definition of done
- All four requirements delivered with unit tests passing
- No ActionMenu or hotspot path remains


## Non-functional requirements
- Overlay recomputes on resize without layout thrash


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · Overlay anchor is a pure function of native position, scale, canvas offset and DPR
nodes.body:
Context: PhaserHost computes zoom via computeZoom(w,h,dpr) in frontend/src/phaser/config.ts and re-applies it on resize. There is no function that converts an object's native position to a DOM position. Desired: a pure function takes the object's position, interactionBounds, scale, the whole-number zoom, the canvas offset in CSS pixels and DPR, and returns the top-centre and bottom-centre screen points. Expected result: the overlay can be placed over the canvas at any zoom. Why: anchors must be exact and testable without Phaser.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given position (150,60), bounds 48x96, scale 1, zoom 2, offset (10,20), DPR 1, When anchorFor runs, Then top-centre is (10+(150+24)*2, 20+60*2) and bottom-centre is (10+(150+24)*2, 20+(60+96)*2)
- Given DPR 2 and a device-pixel zoom of 4, When anchorFor runs, Then the CSS-pixel result equals the DPR 1 zoom 2 result
- Given an object without interactionBounds, When anchorFor runs, Then it returns null


## Scope
- In scope: Pure anchor maths module
- In scope: Reading canvas offset and zoom from the Phaser host on resize
- Out of scope: Rendering the overlay
- Preserve: computeZoom behaviour


## Technical constraints
- Whole-number zoom only; nearest-neighbour
- Phaser stays on 3.90.x
- No position hardcoded; values come from ObjectSpec


## Definition of done
- anchorFor exported and used by the overlay
- PhaserHost reports canvas rect and zoom on resize and DPR change


## Non-functional requirements
- Pure, no DOM or Phaser access inside anchorFor


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · Hover or focus shows a content-driven name plate and action buttons through the existing flow
nodes.body:
Context: objectHover is typed in events.ts but never emitted; SceneObject.onHover only toggles highlight and the Phaser label; ActionMenu is shown only after a click and is not anchored. Desired: BootScene emits objectHover on pointer over/out, an ObjectOverlay component reads the active id (hover or store focusedObjectId), looks the object up in game.view (already filtered by action conditions), and renders a plate with the name upper-cased and a button per action label, positioned by anchorFor. Clicking a button calls game.act(objectId, actionId). Hand cursor is kept on interactive objects. Expected result: the reference-style name plate and INSPECT / SEARCH / PUSH buttons. Why: Done-when 3.8.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given the bookshelf is hovered, When the overlay renders, Then a plate reads the content name upper-cased and one button per available action appears with its content label
- Given a button is clicked, When the handler runs, Then game.act is called with that object id and action id
- Given the pointer leaves the object and nothing is focused, When objectHover emits null, Then the overlay disappears
- Given the interactive image, When created, Then useHandCursor is set for objects with and without bounds


## Scope
- In scope: objectHover emission
- In scope: ObjectOverlay component
- In scope: Replacing ActionMenu in App
- In scope: Hand cursor on bounded objects
- Out of scope: Changing action content
- Out of scope: Restyling Phaser text label
- Preserve: objectClick event
- Preserve: game.act and useGame view filtering


## Technical constraints
- Labels and actions come from the object's content definition only
- Use existing Frame kit and palette tokens
- React, Tailwind, Zustand stay


## Dependencies
- REQ1


## Definition of done
- ObjectOverlay replaces ActionMenu in App
- ActionMenu.tsx removed


## Non-functional requirements
- Buttons use the shared four-state Button styling


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · Every object and action is reachable by keyboard and screen reader from game state
nodes.body:
Context: BootScene.onKeyDown moves focus with Tab/arrows, writes focusedObjectId to the store, and Enter/Space activate the focused object via objectClick. Nothing announces the focus and the DOM has no labelled list of objects. Desired: the overlay region has role=group with aria-label from the object name, buttons carry aria-label like 'Inspect Old Bookshelf', Enter on a focused object moves DOM focus to its first action button, Tab/arrows/Enter/Space then work between action buttons, Escape closes via menuClose, and an aria-live=polite region announces the focused object and its actions from the same store state. Expected result: usable without a mouse or sight. Why: Done-when 3.9.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given focusedObjectId changes to bookshelf, When the live region renders, Then it contains the object name and its action labels
- Given an object is selected, When the overlay renders, Then each button has an aria-label combining action label and object name
- Given focus is on an action button, When Enter or Space is pressed, Then game.act is called for that action
- Given the overlay is open, When Escape is pressed, Then menuClose clears the selection


## Scope
- In scope: ARIA labels and live region
- In scope: DOM focus move to actions
- In scope: Escape close
- Out of scope: Screen-reader testing in a real browser
- Preserve: BootScene key mapping
- Preserve: focusChange and menuClose events


## Technical constraints
- Labels come from the same game state and content as the visuals
- Radix and Tailwind stay


## Dependencies
- REQ2


## Definition of done
- Live region and labels implemented in ObjectOverlay


## Non-functional requirements
- Announcements use aria-live polite


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.summary: Create the pure anchor function and expose canvas rect and zoom on resize.
nodes.description: Add frontend/src/lib/anchor.ts exporting anchorFor and have PhaserHost report its canvas rect and zoom through an optional onLayout callback on mount, resize and DPR change.
acceptance_criteria: anchorFor returns top-centre and bottom-centre CSS-pixel points from position, bounds, scale, zoom, offset and DPR
PhaserHost calls onLayout with {left, top, zoom, dpr} after every applyZoom

steps.action: Create exported type AnchorInput {position:{x:number;y:number}; bounds?:{x:number;y:number;width:number;height:number}; scale:number; zoom:number; offset:{left:number;top:number}; dpr:number} and function anchorFor(input) returning {top:{x,y}; bottom:{x,y}} in CSS pixels or null when bounds is undefined. cssZoom = zoom / dpr; top.x = offset.left + (position.x + (bounds.x + bounds.width/2)*scale)*cssZoom; top.y = offset.top + (position.y + bounds.y*scale)*cssZoom; bottom.y uses bounds.y+bounds.height.

Add optional prop onLayout?: (l:{left:number;top:number;zoom:number;dpr:number})=>void to PhaserHostProps. After the initial createGame call and at the end of applyZoom, read container.getBoundingClientRect() and call onLayout?.({left:r.left, top:r.top, zoom:currentZoom(), dpr:window.devicePixelRatio}).
steps.code: onLayout?.({ left: r.left, top: r.top, zoom: currentZoom(), dpr: window.devicePixelRatio });
